full_page.content:
1933, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 123 Cont.
July 8 Aurelia Martin - 66 - son studying - losing prop. Adele Premean - 78 - Stroke .... Ralph Cook - non Cath. - sore foot.
Page 124 Page 125
Blank Page
July Thanks Peter Martin - 42 - cancer of lung. Enrolled June 21 (50c) wife promising perpetual enrollment if ... Dr. Marveled ... seems out of danger.
Gertrude Peters - 38 - sleeping sickness of brain given up by spe- cialists all over country, now 95 % improved and out Brit. Colum bia - Expects to be back soon - 100% - Enrolled about Jan.
Sister Monica - 58 - Nurse, dizzy, anxious to be well & work - has good record.
Jos. Camolde - 55 - dropsey, bad liver - Very little hopes of re- covery.
RoseMary McNamara
Eliz. Boyd - 46 - sore lip.
Walter Durand - 25 - mental - Ann Arber
July 18
Tuesday - Loraine Baraykowski - 4 - brights, swollen - 21st reported improving ...
Mary G. - 16 months & baby brother ... Eczema .....
Mrs. S. Hogan Enrolled last night 9:30 by phone - bleeding from drawn teeth - 103 fever, slept well, fever this a.m. still at 100 - wife of police Lieut.
Garland - Haberaft ... Roy Vandekesckhove - 25 mo. - Rupture - cured. Mrs. Schneider - 61 - trying to get "back pay".
Page 126 Blank Page.
